messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up: we agreed on several alert-tuning experiments to reduce recurring pager noise. Short thread to assign owners, acceptance metrics, and safe rollouts.

Maya: Key problems: exporter spike churn at 02:00 UTC, prediction-service threshold flaps, repeated DB connection errors across AZs, and high-volume low-severity pages during deploy windows.

Omar: I can own clustering + probabilistic suppression. Idea: cluster identical alerts in recent window (5m) and assign a single page with a summary instead of N pages. Will prototype a cluster-summary payload and a 10m collapse. Target: 2026-04-12.

Lina: I'll take dynamic thresholds for prediction-service. Plan: implement a short-term moving-percentile threshold (p95 over 1h with decay) so thresholds adapt to load spikes, run 7d backtest, then canary. Acceptance: FP drop >=30% without MTTR regressions. Target: 2026-04-08.

Ben: I'll own cross-AZ dedupe + deploy-window routing. Steps: add signature-based dedupe (service+err_class+topframe8), implement a deploy-window rule to route low-sev alerts to #deploy-notify during deploy hours, and add a manual unmute flow. Target: 2026-04-15.

Maya: Nice split. For metrics, please include baseline_nightly_pager_count, clustered_pages, suppressed_pages, unique_alert_signatures, median_time_to_ack. Ops-bot, create ticket and calendar.

Omar: cluster prototype snippet (WIP):
```
algorithm: rolling-cluster
window: 5m
summarize: true
max_summary_items: 5
emit_mode: single-page
```
I'll include rollout: canary at 10% then 50% then 100%.

Lina: backtest query (PromQL):
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, prediction_memory_usage_bytes[1h])
```
Backtest will compare alert counts and FP rate for static vs dynamic thresholds over 14d.

Ben: dedupe config example (WIP):
```
- name: az-conn-dedupe
  signature_fields: ["service","error.class","stack_hash:8"]
  fingerprint: blake2b
  window: 15m
  visibility: ["suppressed_count","sample_ids"]
```
Deploy-window routing snippet:
```
deploy_window:
  hours: [01,02,03]
  routes: {P3: "#deploy-notify", P2: "email"}
```
Will add runbook for opt-out and urgent escalation.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-5091 and assigned to <@Omar> (cluster) due 2026-04-12, <@Lina> (dynamic-thresholds) due 2026-04-08, <@Ben> (dedupe+deploy-route) due 2026-04-15. Recurring meeting: Alert Ops Review (biweekly) starting 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC.

Omar: verification query I'll add:
```
sum by(service)(increase(alerts_fired_total[1d])) - sum by(service)(increase(alerts_clustered_total[1d]))
```
I will attach cluster telemetry to the ticket.

Lina: will run a 14d backtest today and post a short report with candidate decay constants and expected FP reduction. Also adding automatic revert if FP rate spikes >2x.

Ben: adding webhook when suppressed_rate > 35% in 1h to #eng-oncall and a simple "unmute" slash command for oncall. Will include a canary at 5% of traffic first.

Maya: Two small asks: 1) each ticket must include an explicit verification query we can run each morning, 2) coordinate with Support so they know what to expect. Also include a clear rollback plan.

Omar: ack, will include dashboard panel and a one-click disable in canary.

Lina: ack, I'll ping Support and include a short note in the ticket describing symptoms to expect.

Ben: opening branches now. Will post PRs with runbook snippets and canary checklist.

Maya: Thanks team 44D. I'll notify Product & CS and follow up in the first Alert Ops Review. Please post progress updates to INFR-5091 and ping here for blockers.
